name: swarm
description: Coordinate useful native Codex teams with task-aware routing, a local board, safe handoffs, and independent verification. Additional agents use quota.

interface.longDescription: Route coding, research, writing, planning, extraction, and computer-use work to the smallest useful native team. Keep trivial/status work direct. Use explicit ownership, role-compatible reuse, a durable local board, and independent review of the current revision. Adaptive model selection is opt-in and uses advertised capabilities; user pins take precedence. Requires local Python 3 and native subagent tools. No server, scheduler, or dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Use Swarm to choose the smallest useful team for this task.
Show the status of this task's Swarm board.
